title.zh: Hackers mint trillions in fake Bitcoin, but 15 BTC bridge recovery leaves liquidity providers unpaid

current_state.zh: Symbiosis recovered roughly 15 BTC after an attacker exploited its native Bitcoin Bridge on Sep. 11, but affected liquidity providers still lack compensation terms as a bounty deadline approaches.
